# ADR 0003: Maker-checker for actions that move money or affect customers

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Fraud case management service

## Context

One person must not be able to block a card or refund on their own.

## Decision

Actions are proposed and approved by different people with different roles; both identities are stored.

## Consequences

Fraud-resistant and auditable. Slower for urgent actions (define an emergency path).

## Alternatives considered

Single-step actions.
